cost_tolerance: 8*abs(spacing(optimal_cost)) for tied optimum; exact scalar comparison used within production selectors
epsilon_reason: fixed numerical denominator safeguard in frozen cost units; not data-tuned
selection_protocol: 30 independent seeds for Random and CPU Analytic QMF; deterministic Beam and Recursive once per budget
random: without replacement, inspect min(B,N) cost entries
beam: width=min(B,N); real feasible preorder-action trie, retain highest prefix prior mass, deterministic action-key ties; terminal cost evaluations<=B; counts expansions separately
recursive: exact reference not constrained by B, direct conditional optimization, separate reported resources
beam_limits: partial-state expansion and prior preprocessing are not interchangeable with cost-query budgets
selection_sampling: outcome-blind farthest-point coverage of rank(size,density,query count,depth), deterministic random tie breaks; candidates deduplicated by actual membership; root forced first
case_selection: first restrict to positive Greedy root regret, <=20000 points and complete H3 plans; choose nearest 75th percentile positive normalized regret, deterministic key tie; report full-sample percentile
representative_queries: overlap node and hit data; select query nearest median positive leaf-work difference between compared plans, then maximal gap as optional second; report workload percentiles
full_commit_ablation: optional, not executed unless core three experiments complete
